claims.statement: Frozen ENU scenario-bound control tape with strict timegrid and SHA-256 contract

claims.statement: In VEAP's deterministic 2-D toy benchmark (v0.7-x1; 3 held-out test scenarios x 20 seeded perturbations), the obstacle-ignoring greedy baseline without the safety gate reached its goal but failed verification in 34 of 60 runs (0.57; scenario-clustered 95% CI 0-1, n = 3 scenarios); 34 of 40 conditional on completion; greedy never completes absence-rejection (0/20).
claims.scope: Toy 2-D kinematic simulator, test split run once at frozen perturbation level L3; metric demonstration only
claims.limitations: Not an estimate of real-agent behaviour; greedy ignores obstacles by construction; n = 3 scenarios gives an uninformative clustered CI; injected-dropout faults not measured (ledger has no fault event for dropout)

claims.statement: With the geometric safety gate on, safety violations were 0 in all 60 v0.7-x1 test runs of the greedy baseline (also 0 in all 60 route-planner runs).
claims.scope: Toy 2-D kinematic simulator, v0.7-x1 test split, perturbation level L3, seeds 0..19
claims.limitations: Geometric gate checked against the same toy geometry it uses; not a physical safety or control-barrier guarantee

claims.statement: Exploratory: the route planner without the gate failed verification in 1 of 60 v0.7-x1 test runs (3 violations, distribution-shift).
claims.scope: Exploratory secondary observation, toy 2-D simulator, v0.7-x1 test split
claims.limitations: Not pre-registered as an endpoint; single failing run; clustered 95% CI for mean violations 0-0.2 with n = 3 scenarios

claims.statement: v0.6 kinematic planar cross-engine replay agreement (MuJoCo x Isaac Lab): release gate FAILED 18/20 (gate_passed = false; insp-07, insp-08 failed on contact-state disagreement).
claims.scope: 40 kinematic traces (372 samples), gravity disabled planar surrogate at z = 0.16 m, tapes from the same generator as the manifest
claims.limitations: Not native-physics equivalence; gravity disabled; about 9 samples per trace; audit was internal (labelled 'Independent Audit Subagent' in the artifact, which is an internal agent)

claims.statement: Protocol and custody: hash-linked event ledger and trace verifier, exercised by tests/test_adversarial_fixtures.py with fixtures numbered 1..37 and 38 test functions.
claims.scope: Software-unit tests of the toy-world ledger and verifier
claims.limitations: Adversarial fixtures are author-written; no external red-team or external custody demonstrated

claims.statement: Legacy table, v0.x, seed-invariant (effective n = 5 scenarios): greedy gate-off 12/15 completed, 3/15 verified, 147 violations; ungated greedy completion-without-verification occurs in 3 of 5 scenarios.
claims.scope: Legacy 60 nominal runs (5 scenarios x 3 seeds x 2 policies x 2 gates); artifact regenerated so scenario_sha256 matches current contracts
claims.limitations: 16 of 20 cells seed-invariant; splits mixed; no CIs; metric demonstration by construction; superseded by E103
